news.headline: Brookline starts Perimeter at buy; PT C$1.54
news.summary: Brookline Capital Markets initiated research coverage on Perimeter Medical Imaging AI with a Buy rating and a C$1.54 price target, citing Claire's FDA Breakthrough Device status and the company's pending CMS New Technology APC reimbursement filing, with a decision expected by year-end 2026. The stock had closed at C$0.32 on July 13, 2026 ahead of the initiation.

news.headline: Perimeter Medical Imaging AI to Participate in the Planet MicroCap Showcase in Las Vegas
news.summary: Perimeter announced that CEO Adrian Mendes would present a corporate update on the company's commercial strategy and upcoming milestones at the Planet MicroCap Showcase in Las Vegas on June 17, 2026. The presentation gave investors a post-FDA-approval update on Claire and S-Series OCT commercialization progress.

news.headline: Perimeter Selected for INOVAIT Pilot Fund to Advance AI for Breast Cancer Surgery
news.summary: Perimeter Medical Imaging AI was selected to receive a contribution from the INOVAIT Pilot Fund to help advance next-generation AI capabilities for its flagship Claire imaging device. The funding supports continued development of the AI-enabled OCT platform used for real-time breast cancer surgical margin assessment.

catalysts.label: CMS New Technology APC decision for Claire OCT
catalysts.detail: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services is expected to rule on Perimeter's New Technology Ambulatory Payment Classification (NT-APC) filing for Claire under the Medicare Outpatient Prospective Payment System; Claire's FDA Breakthrough Device status is expected to expedite the review.

catalysts.label: Potential NT-APC reimbursement effective date
catalysts.detail: If CMS grants New Technology APC status following a June filing cycle, incremental Medicare reimbursement for Claire procedures would take effect around January 1, 2027 and remain in place for roughly 2-3 years while claims data is collected ahead of reassignment to a standard APC.

catalysts.label: Second quarter 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Perimeter is expected to report Q2 2026 (period ended June 30, 2026) financial and operating results; based on the Q1 2026 reporting cadence, no official date had been announced as of August 4, 2026.

pulse: Perimeter Medical Imaging AI is commercializing Claire, the first FDA-approved AI-enabled OCT imaging device for real-time intraoperative breast cancer margin assessment, following its March 2026 PMA approval, while continuing to expand its base of S-Series OCT hospital placements. The company remains pre-profitability and reliant on dilutive financing (a C$6.8M+ LIFE Offering closed in spring 2026), though Q1 2026 results showed narrowing losses and recurring revenue growth, and Brookline Capital Markets initiated coverage in July 2026 with a Buy rating built largely around the pending CMS New Technology APC reimbursement decision expected by year-end 2026. The stock trades as a thinly-traded, small-cap name on the TSXV (PINK) and OTCQX (PYNKF), with the Medicare reimbursement pathway seen as the key near-term catalyst for broader hospital adoption economics.
